_mfa_codes_body.html: <textarea readonly rows="{{ codes|length }}" cols="14" class="data-mono" id="mfa-codes-copy">
_mfa_setup_body.html: <input type="text" name="code" id="mfa-enroll-code" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="one-time-code" maxlength="10" required{{ fe.invalid_attrs(request, 'mfa-enroll-code', 'mfa-enroll-help', when=(error_field|default('') == 'mfa-enroll-code')) }} />
accept.html: <input type="text" name="username" autocomplete="username" value="{{ inv.email }}" readonly />
<input type="text" name="name" id="accept-name" autocomplete="name" value="{{ name|default('') }}" autofocus />

<input type="password" name="password" id="accept-password" autocomplete="new-password" minlength="{{ password_rules().min_length }}" required{{ fe.invalid_attrs(request, 'accept-password', 'accept-password-rules', when=(error_field|default('') == 'accept-password')) }} />

<input type="password" name="confirm" id="accept-confirm" autocomplete="new-password" minlength="{{ password_rules().min_length }}" required{{ fe.invalid_attrs(request, 'accept-confirm', when=(error_field|default('') == 'accept-confirm')) }} />
account.html: <input type="text" name="username" autocomplete="username" value="{{ me.email }}" readonly />

<input type="password" name="new" id="account-new-password" autocomplete="new-password" minlength="{{ password_rules().min_length }}" required{{ fe.invalid_attrs(request, 'account-new-password', 'account-password-rules', when=(page_error(request) and not page_error(request).field and not page_error(request).anchor)) }} />

<input type="password" name="confirm" id="account-confirm-password" autocomplete="new-password" minlength="{{ password_rules().min_length }}" required{{ fe.invalid_attrs(request, 'account-confirm-password') }} />
<input type="text" name="code" id="mfa-regen-code" autocomplete="one-time-code" maxlength="20" required{{ fe.invalid_attrs(request, 'mfa-regen-code', 'mfa-regen-help') }} />
<form method="post" action="/account/mfa/disable" class="form mt" data-action-confirm="Turn off two-step sign-in? Signing in will then need only your password.">
<input type="password" name="current" id="mfa-disable-current" autocomplete="current-password" required {{ fe.invalid_attrs(request, 'mfa-disable-current') }} />
<input type="text" name="code" id="mfa-disable-code" autocomplete="one-time-code" maxlength="20" required{{ fe.invalid_attrs(request, 'mfa-disable-code', 'mfa-disable-help') }} />
<input type="radio" name="theme" value="light"{% if _theme == 'light' %} checked{% endif %} />
<input type="radio" name="theme" value="dark"{% if _theme == 'dark' %} checked{% endif %} />
<input type="radio" name="theme" value="system"{% if _theme == 'system' %} checked{% endif %} />
<input class="linkbox" readonly aria-label="New API key" value="{{ new_key }}" data-select-on-click />
<input type="number" name="expires_in_days" min="1" step="1" placeholder="no expiry" style="width: 6em" />
account_mfa.html: <input type="password" name="current" id="mfa-current" autocomplete="current-password" required {{ fe.invalid_attrs(request, 'mfa-current', when=(error_field|default('') == 'mfa-current')) }} />
login.html: <input type="text" name="email" id="login-username" autocomplete="username" value="{{ username|default('') }}" required autofocus{{ fe.invalid_attrs(request, 'login-username', when=credential_error|default(false)) }} />
<input type="password" name="password" id="login-password" autocomplete="current-password" required{{ fe.invalid_attrs(request, 'login-password', when=credential_error|default(false)) }} />
mfa_verify.html: <input type="text" name="code" id="mfa-code" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="one-time-code" maxlength="10" required{% if not recovery_open %} autofocus{% endif %}{{ fe.invalid_attrs(request, 'mfa-code', 'mfa-code-help', when=(error_field|default('') == 'mfa-code')) }} />

<input type="text" name="recovery" id="mfa-recovery" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="none" spellcheck="false" maxlength="20" required{% if recovery_open %} autofocus{% endif %}{{ fe.invalid_attrs(request, 'mfa-recovery', 'mfa-recovery-help', when=(error_field|default('') == 'mfa-recovery')) }} />
password_change.html: <input type="text" name="username" autocomplete="username" value="{{ me.email }}" readonly />

<input type="password" name="current" id="pwc-current" autocomplete="current-password" required autofocus{{ fe.invalid_attrs(request, 'pwc-current', when=(error_field|default('') == 'pwc-current')) }} />

<input type="password" name="new" id="pwc-new" autocomplete="new-password" minlength="{{ rules.min_length }}" required{{ fe.invalid_attrs(request, 'pwc-new', 'pwc-rules', when=(error_field|default('') == 'pwc-new')) }} />

<input type="password" name="confirm" id="pwc-confirm" autocomplete="new-password" minlength="{{ rules.min_length }}" required{{ fe.invalid_attrs(request, 'pwc-confirm', when=(error_field|default('') == 'pwc-confirm')) }} />
users.html: <input class="linkbox" readonly aria-label="Invite link" value="{{ invite_link }}" data-select-on-click />
<option value="{{ r }}"{% if r == "viewer" %} selected{% endif %}>
<form method="post" action="/users/invite/{{ inv.id }}/revoke" data-action-confirm="Delete the expired invitation for {{ inv.email }}? The old link stays dead. You can send a new invite later.">
<button type="submit" class="danger-btn" aria-label="Delete invitation for {{ inv.email }}">
<option value="{{ r }}"{% if r == "viewer" %} selected{% endif %}>
<input type="search" name="q" value="{{ q or '' }}" placeholder="Search by email or name" autocomplete="off" />
<option value="{{ r }}" {% if r == u.role %}selected{% endif %}>
<button type="submit" class="btn-small" aria-label="Save role for {{ u.email }}">
<input type="text" name="department" aria-label="Department for {{ u.email }}" value="{{ u.department or '' }}" size="10" placeholder="(none)" />
<button type="submit" class="btn-small" aria-label="Save department for {{ u.email }}">
<option value="{{ c.id }}" {% if c.id == u.customer_id %}selected{% endif %}>
<button type="submit" class="btn-small" aria-label="Save customer for {{ u.email }}">

<form method="post" action="/users/{{ u.id }}/toggle"{% if u.active %} data-action-confirm="Disable {{ u.email }}? They are signed out everywhere and their API keys are revoked for good; re-enabling does not bring them back.{% if scim_token_owner_ids and u.id in scim_token_owner_ids %} This account owns a SCIM token: your identity provider's user sync stops until an administrator creates a new SCIM token for another active administrator and enters it in the identity provider.{% endif %}"{% endif %}>

<button type="submit" role="menuitem" data-busy-keep-label title="{{ 'Disable: signs this person out everywhere and revokes their API keys' if u.active else 'Re-enable: they sign in again and create new API keys' }}">

<form method="post" action="/users/{{ u.id }}/mfa-reset" data-action-confirm="Reset two-step sign-in for {{ u.email }}? Their authenticator setup and recovery codes are deleted and they are signed out everywhere. If it is required for them, they set it up again at their next sign-in.">
<button type="submit" role="menuitem" aria-label="Reset two-step sign-in for {{ u.email }}" data-busy-keep-label>

<form method="post" action="/users/{{ u.id }}/erase" data-action-confirm="Erase {{ u.email }}? This anonymizes the account and rewrites all their attribution to a tombstone. It is irreversible (audit history is kept).">
